subject: Design and Technologies
description: Design and Technologies complete progression map — 6 year levels, 124 standards, 10 strands. Merged from 5 source files.

standards.title: Designed products and environments
standards.description: explore how familiar products, services and environments are designed by people
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how familiar products, services and environments are designed by people.

standards.title: Design and make solutions
standards.description: generate, communicate and evaluate design ideas, and use materials, equipment and steps to safely make a solution for a purpose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students generate, communicate and evaluate design ideas, and use materials, equipment and steps to safely make a solution for a purpose.

standards.title: Digital systems for a purpose
standards.description: Recognise and explore digital systems (hardware and software) for a purpose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and explore digital systems, identifying hardware and software components used for a purpose.

standards.title: Data as objects and symbols
standards.description: Represent data as objects, pictures and symbols
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent data using objects, pictures and symbols.

standards.title: Identify personal data
standards.description: Identify some data that is personal and owned by them
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify some data that is personal and owned by them.

standards.title: Designed solutions for needs
standards.description: identify how familiar products, services and environments are designed and produced by people to meet personal or local community needs and sustainability
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify how familiar products, services and environments are designed and produced to meet personal or local community needs and sustainability.

standards.title: Materials affect movement
standards.description: explore how technologies including materials affect movement in products
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how technologies, including materials, affect movement in products.

standards.title: Growing plants and animals
standards.description: explore how plants and animals are grown for food, clothing and shelter
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how plants and animals are grown for food, clothing and shelter.

standards.title: Selecting and preparing food
standards.description: explore how food can be selected and prepared for healthy eating
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how food can be selected and prepared for healthy eating.

standards.title: Describe, draw and model ideas
standards.description: generate and communicate design ideas through describing, drawing or modelling, including using digital tools
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students generate and communicate design ideas through describing, drawing or modelling, including using digital tools.

standards.title: Safely make designed solutions
standards.description: use materials, components, tools, equipment and techniques to safely make designed solutions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use materials, components, tools, equipment and techniques to safely make designed solutions.

standards.title: Evaluate success and sustainability
standards.description: evaluate the success of design ideas and solutions based on personal preferences and including sustainability
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students evaluate the success of design ideas and solutions based on personal preferences and including sustainability.

standards.title: Sequence making steps cooperatively
standards.description: sequence steps for making designed solutions cooperatively
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students sequence steps for making designed solutions cooperatively.

standards.title: Digital systems and components
standards.description: Identify and explore digital systems and their components for a purpose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify and explore digital systems and their components, explaining how they are used for a purpose.

standards.title: Data as pictures, numbers and words
standards.description: Represent data as pictures, symbols, numbers and words
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students represent data using pictures, symbols, numbers and words.

standards.title: Investigate problems for users
standards.description: Investigate simple problems for known users that can be solved with digital systems
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate simple problems for known users that can be solved with digital systems.

standards.title: Discuss existing digital systems
standards.description: Discuss how existing digital systems satisfy identified needs for known users
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students discuss how existing digital systems satisfy identified needs for known users.

standards.title: Create and communicate content
standards.description: Use the basic features of common digital tools to create, locate and communicate content
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use basic features of digital tools to create, locate and communicate content.

standards.title: Share content and collaborate
standards.description: Use the basic features of common digital tools to share content and collaborate demonstrating agreed behaviours, guided by trusted adults
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use basic features of digital tools to share content and collaborate, demonstrating agreed behaviours guided by trusted adults.

standards.title: Access accounts with credentials
standards.description: Access their school account with a recorded username and password
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students access their school account using a recorded username and password.

standards.title: Personal data stored online
standards.description: Discuss that some websites and apps store their personal data online
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students discuss how websites and apps store personal data online.

standards.title: Follow algorithms with branching
standards.description: Follow and describe algorithms involving a sequence of steps, branching (decisions) and iteration (repetition)
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students follow and describe algorithms involving sequences, branching and iteration.

standards.title: Design occupations and sustainability
standards.description: examine design and technologies occupations and factors including sustainability that impact on the design of products, services and environments to meet community needs
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students examine design and technologies occupations and factors, including sustainability, that impact the design of products, services and environments to meet community needs.

standards.title: Forces and material function
standards.description: describe how forces and the properties of materials affect function in a product or system
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe how forces and the properties of materials affect function in a product or system.

standards.title: Ways of producing food and fibre

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe the ways food and fibre are produced.

standards.title: Healthy food preparation choices
standards.description: describe the ways food can be selected and prepared for healthy eating
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students describe the ways food can be selected and prepared for healthy eating.

standards.title: Explore needs and test materials

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore needs or opportunities for designing, and test materials, components, tools, equipment and processes needed to create designed solutions.

standards.title: Communicate design decisions

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students generate and communicate design ideas and decisions using appropriate attributions, technical terms and graphical representation techniques, including using digital tools.

standards.title: Select tools and techniques
standards.description: select and use materials, components, tools, equipment and techniques to safely make designed solutions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students select and use materials, components, tools, equipment and techniques to safely make designed solutions.

standards.title: Use criteria to evaluate solutions
standards.description: use given or co-developed design criteria including sustainability to evaluate design ideas and solutions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use given or co-developed design criteria, including sustainability, to evaluate design ideas and solutions.

standards.title: Sequence collaborative production
standards.description: sequence steps to individually and collaboratively make designed solutions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students sequence steps to individually and collaboratively make designed solutions.

standards.title: Digital systems and peripherals
standards.description: Explore and describe a range of digital systems and their peripherals for a variety of purposes
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore and describe a range of digital systems and peripherals, explaining how they serve different purposes.

standards.title: Transmitting data between systems
standards.description: Explore transmitting different types of data between digital systems
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore how different types of data are transmitted between digital systems.

standards.title: Data types and representations
standards.description: Recognise different types of data and explore how the same data can be represented differently depending on the purpose
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise different types of data and explain how the same data can be represented in different ways depending on purpose.

standards.title: Define problems with user stories
standards.description: Define problems with given design criteria and by co-creating user stories
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students define problems using given design criteria and co-created user stories.

standards.title: Generate and compare designs
standards.description: Generate, communicate and compare designs
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students generate, communicate and compare design ideas.

standards.title: Evaluate against design criteria
standards.description: Discuss how existing and student solutions satisfy the design criteria and user stories
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students discuss how existing and student solutions satisfy design criteria and user stories.

standards.title: Create content with conventions
standards.description: Use the core features of common digital tools to create, locate and communicate content, following agreed conventions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use core features of digital tools to create, locate and communicate content, following agreed conventions.

standards.title: Plan tasks and collaborate
standards.description: Use the core features of common digital tools to share content, plan tasks, and collaborate, following agreed behaviours, supported by trusted adults
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use core features of digital tools to share content, plan tasks and collaborate, following agreed behaviours.

standards.title: Memorised passwords

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students access accounts using memorised passwords and explain what makes a strong password.

standards.title: Personal data risks online
standards.description: Identify what personal data is stored and shared in their online accounts and discuss any associated risks
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify personal data stored in online accounts and discuss associated risks.

standards.title: Describe algorithms with operators
standards.description: Follow and describe algorithms involving sequencing, comparison operators (branching) and iteration
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students follow and describe algorithms involving sequencing, comparison operators and iteration.

standards.title: Implement visual programs
standards.description: Implement simple algorithms as visual programs involving control structures and input
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students implement simple algorithms as visual programs involving control structures and input.

standards.title: Competing factors in design

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how people in design and technologies occupations consider competing factors, including sustainability, in the design of products, services and environments.

standards.title: Electrical energy transformations
standards.description: explain how electrical energy can be transformed into movement, sound or light in a product or system
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how electrical energy can be transformed into movement, sound or light in a product or system.

standards.title: Managed food and fibre production

standards.title: Food characteristics and preparation

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how the characteristics of foods influence selection and preparation for healthy eating.

standards.title: Properties affect material use

standards.title: Investigate needs and processes

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate needs or opportunities for designing, and the materials, components, tools, equipment and processes needed to create designed solutions.

standards.title: Iterate and communicate designs

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students generate, iterate and communicate design ideas, decisions and processes using technical terms and graphical representation techniques, including using digital tools.

standards.title: Use suitable materials and techniques

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students select and use suitable materials, components, tools, equipment and techniques to safely make designed solutions.

standards.title: Negotiate criteria for evaluation

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students negotiate design criteria, including sustainability, to evaluate design ideas, processes and solutions.

standards.title: Develop project plans and resources

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop project plans that include consideration of resources to individually and collaboratively make designed solutions.

standards.title: Internal components and function

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students investigate and explain the main internal components of digital systems and their functions.

standards.title: Networks and data transmission

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how digital systems form networks to transmit data.

standards.title: Data represented as numbers
standards.description: Explain how digital systems represent all data using numbers
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explain how digital systems use numbers to represent all types of data.

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students define problems using given or co-developed design criteria and independently created user stories.

standards.title: Design a user interface

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students design a user interface for a digital system.

standards.title: Generate, modify and evaluate designs
standards.description: Generate, modify, communicate and evaluate designs
